questions.stem: A company member is opening an employee bowling team. The cost to have the team is \$140 per team member plus a one-time \$25 team registration fee. What is the maximum number of team members who can join the team if the company can spend \$935 for the bowling team?

Hakim has a bag of $50$ tiles, where $45$ are labeled with a letter and $5$ are blank. If Hakim selects a tile from the bag at random, what is the probability of selecting a blank tile? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction, not as a percent.)

The value of a painting increased by $166\%$ from the end of 2011 to the end of 2012 and then decreased by $14\%$ from the end of 2012 to the end of 2013. What was the net percentage increase in the value of the painting from the end of 2011 to the end of 2013?

The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, $x$ and $u$. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. For how many of the $9$ data points does the line of best fit predict a $y$-value that is less than the actual $y$-value?
$y = 3x^3 + 8 \quad y = 363x + 8$ A solution to the given system of equations is $(x, y) = (a, b)$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants. If $b \leq 0$, what is the value of $a$?
There is a proportional relationship between $p$ and $t$. If $p=2{,}520$ when $t=3{,}360$, then what is the value of $t$ when $p=2{,}016$?
The perimeter of a square can be expressed as $4(76)$ units. What is the length, in units, of a side of this square?

$x(x+3)-1=0$ What are the solutions to the given equation?

questions.stem: The table shows three values of $x$ and their corresponding values of $y$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants. There is a linear relationship between $x$ and $y$. In the $xy$-plane, the $y$-intercept of the line representing this relationship is $(0,-14)$. What is the value of $a+b$? The table gives: $x=-12$, $y=46$; $x=a$, $y=16$; $x=2$, $y=b$.

figures.alt: Table of x and y: (-12, 46), (a, 16), (2, b).

questions.stem: A circle has a circumference of $10\pi$ centimeters. What is the diameter, in centimeters, of the circle?

A team of researchers plans to spend no more than $310$ hours in total collecting observation data for two projects. For one of the projects, the team will observe at least $13$ penguins and will spend $5$ hours observing the behavior of each penguin. For the other project, the team will observe at least $16$ seals and will spend $6$ hours observing the behavior of each seal. Based on this plan, what is the maximum number of penguins the team can observe?

In the xy-plane, circle M is the graph of the equation $(x - 6)^2 +$ $(y - 3)^2 = 4$. Circle P has the same center as circle M but has a radius that is twice the radius of circle M. Which equation represents circle P?
If $\frac{j}{k}=83$ and $\frac{44j}{22xk}=83$, what is the value of $x$?
Circle N has a radius of $9$ millimeters (mm). Circle M has an area of $25\pi$ mm$^2$. What is the total area, in mm$^2$, of circles N and M?
The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=\frac{x+11}{5}$, and $f(a)=-18$, where $a$ is a constant. What is the value of $a$?

The given equation represents a parabola in the $xy$-plane. Which of the following equations that represent the same parabola displays the x-intercepts as constants or coefficients?
The binomial $x+3y$ is a factor of which of the following?

A parabola in the xy-plane has a vertex of $(1,35)$. The equation $y=-ax^2+bx+c$ represents this parabola, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are positive integer constants. What is the greatest possible value of $b$?

In the given system of equations, $r$ is a constant. The system has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of $r$?

For a certain type of rope, the equation $y=900ax^2$, where $a$ is a constant, gives the estimated breaking strength $y$, in pounds, of a rope with a circumference of $x$ inches. Based on this equation, if a rope of this type has a circumference of $1.75$ inches, it has an estimated breaking strength of $3{,}858.75$ pounds. What is the estimated breaking strength, in pounds, of a rope of this type that has a circumference of $3.50$ inches?
